content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Retired Central / State Government employees (JE / AE / EE) get last drawn Basic Pay minus pension drawn. Initial period not exceeding one year, extendable by one more year subject to satisfactory performance Total period shall not exceed two years and shall not go beyond the age of 65 years Extension is not automatic and confers no right to renewal May be terminated by either side on one month's notice Purely contractual; no right to regular appointment, regularisation, seniority or promotion

content_sections.heading: How Will ESIC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications for eligibility Personal interview before a Selection Committee Verification of credentials/medical fitness, if applicable Applications screened for eligibility Shortlisted candidates called for personal interview before a Selection Committee constituted by the Competent Authority List of shortlisted candidates and interview schedule displayed on the Regional Office website; no separate communication Carry original documents at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational and professional qualification certificates, and proof of date of birth Service/experience certificate(s), last promotion order and proof of post held at retirement Copy of Pension Payment Order (PPO) with basic pension and commutation details; last pay certificate/last pay slip Vigilance clearance / no-pending-disciplinary-case certificate from last employer, or self-declaration Undertaking regarding no simultaneous engagement/conflict of interest Recent passport-size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Apply in the application format at Annexure-A, filled in capital letters. Super-scribe the Name of the post on the envelope/subject line. Enclose self-attested copies of the listed documents. Send by Speed Post/Registered Post to the Regional Director, ESIC, RO Jaipur, or by e-mail to [email protected] . Application must reach on or before 30/11/2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 2 Junior Engineer (JE) - Electrical, 3 Junior Engineer (JE) - Civil, 1 Assistant Engineer (AE) - Electrical.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-A (page 4 of this notice)) and send it to Regional Director, ESIC, RO Jaipur, Panchdeep Bhawan, Bhawani Singh Road, Jaipur-302001, by speed post / registered post / e-mail, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 65 years (as on the date of commencement of the contractual engagement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 56,000 per month (Retired PSU / Semi-Government employees); Last drawn Basic Pay minus pension drawn (Retired Central / State Government employees) for Junior Engineer (JE) - Electrical, 56,000 per month (Retired PSU / Semi-Government employees); Last drawn Basic Pay minus pension drawn (Retired Central / State Government employees) for Junior Engineer (JE) - Civil, 71,000 per month (Retired PSU / Semi-Government employees); Last drawn Basic Pay minus pension drawn (Retired Central / State Government employees) for Assistant Engineer (AE) - Electrical.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree/Diploma in Civil or Electrical Engineering (as per discipline) from recognised University/Institution; retired Central/State Govt, PSU or Semi-Government employees who held the post of JE / AE or superior posts at retirement from Central/State PWD Department or Central/State Public Sector undertaking. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only retired Central/State Government, PSU or Semi-Government (non-pensionable) employees may apply. Candidate should be free from vigilance/disciplinary angle. Undertaking that candidate is not simultaneously engaged in any conflicting assignment, consultancy or contract. Medical Fitness Certificate from a Govt. Civil Surgeon before joining.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications for eligibility. Personal interview before a Selection Committee. Verification of credentials/medical fitness, if applicable. Applications screened for eligibility.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial period not exceeding one year, extendable by one more year subject to satisfactory performance. Total period shall not exceed two years and shall not go beyond the age of 65 years. Extension is not automatic and confers no right to renewal.
